}}'''Moradri''' is a Mayener [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Moradri|Moradri}} She has two [[warder]]s who are rumored to be her brothers.{{ref||Moradri}}

== History ==
Rumor has it that her Warders are her two brothers, though no one has dared comment on it to her.

They are described as "handsome", so are likely not old men. Assuming they are her younger brothers and she is no more than 15 years older than them, she is likely not older than 70, but as young as 30.

== Appearance ==
She is long-limbed and has dark skin.

== Activities ==
She reports to [[Saerin Asnobar]] about the positions of the Aes Sedai during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]].
